name: Agent Onboarding Protocol
description: Onboard a coding agent (zcode/CC) onto this living system: shared-context protocol, file claims, task routing, honesty rules.

steps.description: Read CHECKLIST.md, AGENTS.md, docs/STATE_CAPTURE.md and the shared-context handoffs before touching anything, and summarize what is current and who holds what. Hands on the context. Reading repository files needs a file-read capability that is not registered.
steps.name: read_state

steps.description: State the claims to take (file_claim before editing), how work is routed through host tasks, and the handoff note to end the session with. Hands on claims and tasks. File claims go through the shared-context server, which is not a registered provider here.
steps.name: claim_and_route

steps.description: Probe live state (health, task list, graph) before trusting the docs: verify what is actually active, not just what is built. Hands on the live state. Use only tool results the walk shows; say what could not be probed.
steps.name: verify_live
